notes: Asking Crisp to get rid of something no longer makes it. "Delete the highlight reel", "remove the montage" and "get rid of the music video" each used to plan the very thing you asked to be rid of — and building a montage cuts your timeline down, so it was a confident plan to undo your edit. Asking for one still works exactly as before: "cut out the boring bits", "remove the dead air" and "make a highlight reel" all do what they say.
